scientific_integrity: Direct sign-identity proof for all horizons. Exact-rational finite enumeration is supplementary; no independent assessment or universal priority certification.
scientific_limitations: Applies to i.i.d. symmetric atomless increments and finite positive horizons; gives only two endpoint rank second moments, not the complete joint law. Older 1972 order-statistic research has unresolved priority relevance because full text was inaccessible.
title: Exact universal anticorrelation of the two endpoint ranks of a symmetric random walk
